name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-generated-artifacts
description: The repo's generated artifacts as data: GENERATED_ARTIFACTS (each committed path pattern a build or migration generate writes, with the .gitattributes merge driver that resolves it), GENERATED_TS_SUFFIX, and isGeneratedArtifactPath. A zero-import leaf, so web code (a commit's file-kind classifier) reads the same list as build tooling; its generated-artifacts-attributed check holds the .gitattributes regen lines equal to it.
